This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be 
 carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

Boiler drum is used for feeding walls with water and super heaters with saturated 
 steam

The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Abd El Naeim 
 Attallah Ahmed, accepted by eng. 
 Gomah Lotfy general director, revised by eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil; EDEPC 
 quality control general director, and approved by eng. Mokhter Abd 
 Elatif: head sector of Ataka Power Station (2x300+2x150) MW.

This 
 document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC MPIS coordinator & 
 inspection and quality control general director, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Mohamed Solman EDEPC Admin. & financial inspection, quality 
 control general director and supervisor of inspection & quality control 
 head sector.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified stuff should be carry the 
 suitable safety category .

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, safety 
 glass ... etc.
Boiler out of service and pressure should be zero.
Provide the working area by a good lighting.

Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, safety 
 glass ... etc.
Boiler out of service and pressure should be zero.

Drain 
 the drum and vents open
Drain all boiler walls and super heaters, re-heaters and economizer.
Provide the working area by a good lighting.

Complete 
 maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid
Suitable lifting device

Check 
 for any leakage from the manholes

Be sure the boiler out of operation and the pressure inside the drum must be 
 zero.
Be sure the drum is drained.
Be sure the vents opened.
Be sure the temperature inside the drum 35 C
Open the two manholes
Check the thickness of the chemical layers
Check the fixation of bolts and nuts for the drum internal parts.
Check on cyclones the first and the second scrubbers
Check the feed tubes opening.
Clean the chemical studies on the drum internal surface .
Replace manhole gaskets.
